decision: A campaign's results become four story cards (views, the moment, where it traveled, earnings), the year-in-review pattern popularized by music-streaming apps, applied to one campaign
why: Artists and labels share stories, not dashboards; a recap they want to post spreads the campaign's result further.
value: Results that get shared, with the dashboard one click behind.

decision: The recap is generated on day 7 at 06:00 KST from the same evidence trail as the dashboards, and campaigns younger than that show when it will arrive
why: Earlier recaps miss the Tokyo and LA waves; a fixed day makes recaps comparable across campaigns.
alternative: Generate on demand at any time.
value: Every recap tells the full story, and numbers match Intelligence and Distribution.

decision: The earnings card is hidden until tapped, and sharing or exporting includes earnings only if they were revealed
why: Recaps travel beyond the team; money should leave only by deliberate choice.

decision: Export as deck draws the four cards on a canvas and downloads a PNG, entirely client-side
why: No server rendering or file storage on the free tier, and the deck matches what's on screen.
value: Instant export with no uploads and no storage costs.

decision: Share with the label sends the cards with evidence links (dashboards, fan-edit trail, split sheet) after an explicit confirmation
why: Labels act on evidence; a recap without its sources invites argument.
